m13.text: Brenalt is a wounded soldier questioned by an inquisitor who suspects he made a deal with a demon for his life. In a flashback, he barricades a ruined shrine and mourns his dead friends Tomas, Edrick and Stanton, and Mattias dies after urging him to run and tell their families.

Brenalt prays wordlessly at the altar and an angel appears in warmth and light. He asks her for help, and she nods, granting him strength in a pact, and the softened inquisitor tells him she believes him.

Brenalt rises rapidly through the ranks to general, rumored to be blessed by the angels, and at a council of war he tells his fellow commanders that angels are alien and cannot be relied on. When a scout reports that the Fourth Legion is lost and River's Glen overrun, he reveals it was his home.

Now crippled and leading a few dozen survivors, Brenalt sees a necromancer directing the dead below. He screams at the heavens that he gave everything and will die fighting, honoring his promise, and raises his staff for one last charge as the wind changes.
